cand.title: Les Hivernales — 17th edition
cand.organizationName: Les Hivernales / Festival à Nyon & Gland
cand.excerpt: Strong local, multi-day event mechanism; accessibility and hotel procurement are unconfirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two relevant named relationship leads, neither a verified hotel-contract buyer: Julien Schindler, identified by One FM on 24 February 2026 as one of the festival programmers; and Amandine Barut Jutzeler, whose professional profile lists a current organizing-committee role covering F&B, security and evening responsibility since March 2022. Schindler can plausibly route artist-hospitality enquiries; Barut Jutzeler can plausibly route operational enquiries. These routing roles are inferences. Neither source establishes 2027 accommodation budget ownership, contracting authority or availability.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced: 17th edition, 4–7 March 2027, Nyon and Gland, Vaud, Switzerland; within the requested horizon. Both the organizer and City of Nyon publish these activity dates. The official website still mixes these dates with 2026 programme headings and an old ticket link; do not treat its displayed artists or ticket inventory as fully verified for 2027. No 2028 edition announcement was found.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: conditional local-territory fit for artist/crew lodging, airport arrivals and possibly a small operational meeting, not relocation of the public festival. The published artist airport/hotel shuttle function is the strongest demand mechanism. YOTEL’s Founex location is relevant to La Côte but not walkable to the Nyon/Gland festival venues; transfer feasibility and late-night service must be agreed, not assumed. Its 237 rooms and six meeting rooms do not establish demand: even the hotel’s 20–120-room commercial band is a qualification range, not a festival estimate. No whole-house or meeting-space requirement is evidenced; resort attributes are not a demonstrated buying criterion.
findings.venueCommitments: Published principal venue: Salle communale de Nyon, Rue des Marchandises 4, 1260 Nyon. Official practical information lists Salle communale, L’Usine à Gaz, La Parenthèse, Fishermen’s Pub, Backstage Pub and La Plage; the programme additionally lists Salle des Marchandises for official afters. Backstage Pub is in Gland, confirmed in the municipal 2026 venue record. All are in the Nyon/Gland–La Côte territory, not Geneva city or Lausanne. These are published festival locations, not evidence of signed 2027 venue contracts. Because the programme retains a 2026 heading, the full edition-specific 2027 venue roster needs organizer confirmation. None of the listed venues is identified as a contracted hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Local recurring multi-venue festival, not a demonstrated rotating-destination congress. Official history dates the first edition to 12–13 February 2010 and records addition of Nyon’s Salle communale in 2011. The 15th edition in 2025 and 16th in 2026 used Nyon/Gland venues; 2027 is again announced for Nyon/Gland. No evidence of a competitive destination or host-hotel rotation was found.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing unconfirmed. Official quote: «Le festival ne dispose pas de camping mais plusieurs hôtels sont à disposition dans la région nyonnaise». No hotels are named in that guidance; no edition-specific host hotel, room block, housing bureau or open accommodation RFP was found. An operational route does exist: the volunteer page describes artist shuttles «entre l’aéroport et/ou l’hôtel et la Salle Communale» and an «accueil artistes» team ensuring artists are fed and lodged. This establishes a lodging function, not available inventory or a purchasing mandate. Separately, a 2022 regional multi-festival accommodation platform facilitated private and professional accommodation; that is not a 2027 festival hotel contract.
findings.organizationStructure: Nonprofit festival organization Les Hivernales, operating through a five-member committee, an expanded group of sector leads and more than 200 volunteers. Committee functions include communications, sponsorship, programming, food/drink and volunteers. Its professional profile classifies it as nonprofit; the official site establishes the operating structure. No external PCO, DMC or housing agency was identified. Association legal registration and current authorized signatory remain unverified; do not confuse the festival owner with its venues or the regional accommodation platform.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No incumbent hotel, exclusive hotel agreement, sold-out accommodation, overflow requirement or peak room count was verified. The official undated series summary says more than 4,500 festivalgoers and more than 90% Swiss artists; neither is a 2027 lodging forecast, and artist nationality does not establish overnight demand. The event’s walkable Nyon-centre format creates an inferred convenience disadvantage for Founex unless organizer transport is available. Do not turn generic regional hotel directories into competitor commitments.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Use the official contact form or info@leshivernales.ch now; request introduction to the 2027 artist-hospitality/accommodation lead, referencing Julien Schindler and Amandine Barut Jutzeler only as relevant routing contacts. Ask who books and pays, contracted hotels and release dates, nightly artist/crew rooms, arrival/departure patterns and airport/late-night shuttle arrangements. Only after those answers, offer a measured room allocation, breakfast/late-arrival arrangements and optional operational meeting space, subject to hotel availability and agreed transport. Do not propose a 20–120-room block as established demand. If committed, seek the next review date rather than claiming an open 2028 RFP.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The upcoming 2027 festival is announced, but commercially accessible hotel inventory is unknown. Artist-hospitality and shuttle functions provide an approach route, not proof that contracts remain open. Start through the official contact form or published info@leshivernales.ch and ask for the 2027 accueil artistes/accommodation lead. Do not use the volunteer recruitment mailbox as a purported procurement address.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue repeat local artist/crew lodging rather than destination rotation or mass public housing. If 2027 accommodation is already contracted, request a debrief and inclusion in the next accommodation review. Recurrence is evidenced by the series history and successive editions; 2028 dates, procurement timetable and future open inventory are not announced in the sources reviewed.
